## Slides

Each session ships a standalone reveal.js deck with the same content as the
corresponding chapters. The slides open full-screen in your browser: use the
arrow keys (or the on-screen controls) to navigate, `F` for full-screen and `S`
for the presenter notes — the notes include what to say and where to pause.

## Session 2 — designing an AI tutor: principles & demo

[Open the Session 2 slides](slides/2026-08-27-seance-2-slides.html)

- Returns the survey results from the room: equipment, existing usage, and how

## Session 3 — designing an AI tutor: the prompt workshop

[Open the Session 3 slides](slides/2026-09-01-seance-3-slides.html)

- Write your v1 tutor *system prompt* from the six-block anatomy of Session 2 —
  role, method, anti-cheating, hallucinations, tone & format, context.
- Test it on three typical questions, a fresh session each.
- Iterate to a v2, peer-review in pairs, and deposit your v1 before Session 4.
